business_identity.business_description: We roast specialty-grade coffee beans and supply cafes and hotels across Riyadh, plus a small direct-to-consumer subscription.

revenue_and_customers.revenue_owner_quote: Last year we did just over 4.2 million.
revenue_and_customers.seasonality_notes: Slower in summer when cafe foot traffic drops.

operations.owner_dependency_evidence: Operations manager runs day-to-day roasting and logistics; owner focuses on sales.

market_position.differentiation: Same-day roasting and delivery within Riyadh, versus competitors who roast weekly batches.

funding_need.purpose_detail: A second roasting machine to keep up with hotel contract volume.

claims.owner_quote: Last year we did just over 4.2 million.
We can roast and deliver same-day, our competitors batch-roast weekly.

plan_inputs.growth_basis: New hotel contracts already signed for next year plus the added roasting capacity.
plan_inputs.management_assessment: Operations manager is capable and has been offered a small equity stake to retain them.
plan_inputs.positioning_notes: The same-day roasting angle is genuinely differentiated in this market — most competitors batch-roast weekly and lose freshness.
plan_inputs.risk_mitigants: Owner has agreed forward contracts with two green-bean suppliers to reduce price volatility exposure.
plan_inputs.use_of_funds_notes: SAR 900,000 for one industrial roasting machine, fully quoted by the supplier.
plan_inputs.market_size_sources: Euromonitor Saudi Coffee Market Report 2025; GASTAT food service statistics 2024
plan_inputs.market_drivers_notes: Rising specialty-coffee consumption among younger Saudi consumers and growth in the boutique hotel segment in Riyadh.

competitor_notes.name: Camel Step Coffee
competitor_notes.strengths: Strong brand recognition, three retail cafes
competitor_notes.weaknesses: Batch-roasts weekly, inconsistent freshness reported by customers
